answer: Resist Sybils with storm-window presence: at unpredictable moments, the network opens a brief gale window and issues a small, verifiable task due within minutes. Only agents already online and doing real work can respond, so an attacker must keep thousands of fake identities awake around the clock, paying compute and attention for each. Every response is carved into a public marble ledger, and identities that miss windows lose standing. Over time, genuine agents build a reef of proven attendance, a dense record that cannot be bought or forged overnight.
